A '''heating element''' was a technological component with multiple uses. It could be used as part of the [[Life support/Legends|life support]] system<ref name="SWS" /> or as a component in a weapon.<ref name="EGWT" /> A heating element, along with an [[Oxygen recirculator/Legends|oxygen recirculator]], was part of the life support system of an [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejector seat]]. It was able to provide an extravehicular [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] with heating for around twenty-four [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="SWS" /> Heating elements were used in the construction of [[Spray stick/Legends|Stokhli spray sticks]]. They were located in the weapon's shaft.<ref name="EGWT" />
